_notes: One segment per reference shot. tts = spoken text, cap = caption (*gold* emphasis, !red! loss, +green+ gain, {TEXT:N} replaces N spoken words).
say = optional spelling fed to the TTS instead of tts (pronunciation fixes); captions/alignment still use tts.

lines.tts: Your money is shrinking right now.
And you didn't even notice.
You got a raise this year.
So why does your money buy less?
lines.cap: So why does your money buy !less?!

lines.tts: It's called inflation.
And it works in silence.
Every year, prices climb.
Groceries. Rent. Gas. Insurance.
Everything.
Meanwhile, the average savings account pays you almost nothing.
lines.cap: Meanwhile, the average savings account pays you almost *nothing.*

lines.tts: So your balance stays the same.
But what it buys keeps shrinking.
A thousand dollars today buys what eight hundred did five years ago.
lines.cap: {*$1,000*:3} today buys what {+$800+:2} did five years ago.

lines.tts: You never spent it.
It just disappeared.
Now here's the part they don't teach you in school.
lines.cap: Now here's the part they *don't* *teach* *you* in school.

lines.tts: When new money enters the economy,
it doesn't reach everyone at the same time.
lines.cap: it doesn't reach *everyone* at the same time.

lines.tts: It flows to the banks first.
Then Wall Street.
Then people who already own assets.
They spend it before prices go up.
lines.cap: They spend it *before* prices go up.

lines.tts: By the time it reaches your paycheck,
everything already costs more.
Economists have a name for this.
lines.cap: Economists have a name for this.

lines.tts: The Cantillon Effect.
It's why people who own homes and stocks get richer during inflation,
lines.cap: It's why people who own +homes+ and +stocks+ get +richer+ during inflation,

lines.tts: while people on a salary fall behind.
Not because they work less.
Because the dollar is designed to lose about two percent of its value.
lines.cap: Because the dollar is *designed* to !lose! about {*2%*:2} of its value.

lines.tts: Every. Single. Year.
So if your money is just sitting still,
lines.cap: So if your money is just sitting still,

lines.tts: you're not being safe.
You're paying for everyone who got the money first.
lines.cap: You're !paying! for everyone who got the money *first.*

lines.tts: Follow for part two: how to protect your money.
